note: h1 = completed 1-hour candles labelled by CLOSE time (10:00 = C1 ... 16:00 = C7); forming = the hour still in progress; daily = completed sessions (last 260); monthly = month candles built from completed sessions, labelled YYYY-MM (the last one is the month in progress); quote = close of the last completed 1-hour candle (t = its close time); full chart history per symbol is in data/chart/<SYM>.json
